snippet.title: Hermit the sluggish caterpillar of the sea - Trailer
snippet.description:
Hermit the lone sluggish caterpillar of the Sea is looking for a new home, if only it weren't for those annoying sea creatures. Help hermit defend his home using the power of shells.
 
 ► Play it here: https://sharpedstonestudios.itch.io/hermit-the-sea-caterpillar
 
 ····················································································
 
 This game was made in 48 hours at the Global Game Jam.
